'''Kellin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] records officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] she was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
Records Officer Kellin appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Guild Registrar on the Imperial fleet.<ref name="SWTOR" />
